outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: Women who delivered at the University Teaching Hospital in Lusaka, Zambia, between January 1, 2008, and December 31, 2012 (62,470 deliveries)
finding: While rates of maternal mortality, cesarean delivery, and hemorrhage during pregnancy declined over the study period, stillbirth rates remained stable and reports of a 5-minute Apgar score of less than 7 rose.
